statements: A1 ownership -> logical member enumeration -> existing L2 backup/restore/migration. Core backup logically includes portable user settings, SM durable authority, Watchlists and required portable facts/pointers. Full governed adds Results/Audits, authorization/control and retained governed provenance. Source ID/runtime/cache/log/temp/absolute path mappings are not portable active authority. L2 remains EXPLICIT_DECLARED_MEMBERS_ONLY, not whole-installation discovery. A1 metadata/settings require later L2 member-family/classification/version adapters; location cannot bypass UNCLASSIFIED_REQUIRES_POLICY. Verified restore is isolated and never activates. MIGRATION_REQUIRED is classification-only; newer unsupported state fails closed; migration is explicit, rollback uses verified A4 retained bytes and replay != refetch. No second backup/migration system.
new_l2_family_integration: A1 metadata/settings not automatically supported; later explicit adapters/compatibility within existing L2
